Elsa (Design): Quick sync: I'm iterating on the token create + rotate microflow. Few small asks: make visibility explicit, reduce support confusion, keep it compact.
Rahul (PM): Nice. Can you summarize the change in one sentence?
Elsa (Design): Show a tiny 'Visibility' row on create with two radio options: 'Ephemeral 1 Only shown once' and 'Recorded 2 Stored & auditable'. Default to Ephemeral.
Jamie (Eng): Backend note: Recorded requires storing retrievable secret (vault + audit). Will be an infra story. Ephemeral stays as-is.
Maya (A11y): Make the "Only shown once" text part of the label and add aria-describedby linking to the tooltip explaining audit implications. Also ensure the reveal drawer gets aria-live="polite".
Rahul (PM): Defaulting to Ephemeral minimizes risk. What about teams that expect shared tokens? Docs link in the success toast should help.
Elsa (Design): Agreed. Toast copy: "Token created 1 — shown once. Copy now or Download .env (contains token). Learn more: token lifecycle". Also change CTA from "Show secret" to "Copy token (shown once)".
Maya (A11y): For "Download .env" clearly announce file name on download and include accessible confirmation when copy completes. Toast should not auto-dismiss quickly.
Jamie (Eng): Rotation: propose an optional 'Grace period' toggle in rotate modal. Default off. If on, default 24h soft-revoke. We'll emit separate audit events for soft vs hard revoke.
Rahul (PM): Ops wants 15m undo window, support wants 24h. Can we ship with 24h for soft-deletes and 15m for hard immediate revokes?
Jamie (Eng): Yes, implementable with a per-org config flag later. UI will show "Undo window: 24h (soft) / 15m (hard)".
Elsa (Design): Revoke CTA copy: replace vague "Are you sure?" with "Revoke token: immediately disable clients. Undo available for X" (X depends on toggle).
Maya (A11y): Modal focus: land on confirm button; Esc should announce "Rotation modal closed". Tooltips must be keyboard accessible.
Rahul (PM): Quick experiment proposal: Variant 1 inline visibility during create. Variant 2 keep it in modal after create. A/B test for support volume.
Jamie (Eng): I'll estimate effort for both. Inline variant touches create endpoint with new fields: visibility & audit_flag. Modal variant only affects post-create settings.
Elsa (Design): Tiny visual: token list shows small status pill: Active / Revoked (soft) / Revoked (hard). Tooltip explains what each means. Keep row height unchanged.
Maya (A11y): Status pills need text labels (not just color). Provide aria-labels like "Revoked (soft): undoable for 24 hours".
ops-bot: ops-bot: "Flagging epic-342: token-visibility for infra review (KMS + audit storage)."
Rahul (PM): Next steps: Elsa posts two quick frames, Jamie returns estimate by EOD, Maya writes a short accessibility checklist, I'll schedule a security check-in.
Elsa (Design): Posting Figma frames in channel shortly. Thanks! :raised_hands:
